tr.description:
The car at the door has its front end caved in. It's sitting right there between you.
"Car has no damage," he says.

Nobody in this trade tells the truth. In a minute.

Haggling
"One owner from new." "Original color, never repainted." "Had it for years, my pride and joy."
If it's his pride and joy, why is he selling it. Not your problem. Your problem is the registration and the inspection report in your hand. If the registration lists three owners, "one owner from new" falls apart on the table and the price comes down with it. Accuse him with nothing in your hand and he tightens up, and so does the price. Nobody tells you the lowest they'll go; you read it in how they give ground. Some of them just get up and leave.

The workshop
You beat the dents out with a hammer, paint the car with your finger, fit rims and a spoiler. What goes in as scrap comes out onto the floor gleaming. The next day a buyer walks in, you say "gently used," and you don't blink.

Auction day
The day opens in the auction hall. You bid against rival dealers. You can go in blind on a lot nobody has opened: sometimes it's a classic, sometimes it's a lesson.

End of day
The ledger closes. Did you turn a profit today, or did you just move cars around? The numbers will tell you.

You're the hunter when you buy. When you sell, you're not.

Bu oyunda hayatının her kararı bir evrak olarak gelir. Okursun, damganı basarsın: ONAY ya da RED. O kadar.

Ama bir sorun var. Gitmek istiyorsun ve konsolosluk her şeye bakıyor: banka hesabına, işine, evine, ailene, seyahat geçmişine. Gidebilmek için önce burada bir hayat kurduğunu kanıtlaman lazım.

NE YAPARSIN
• Okursun, çalışırsın, terfi alırsın ya da kovulursun. Garsonluktan kafe ortaklığına, stajyerlikten CTO'luğa.
• Aile evinden yurda, rutubetli 1+1'den kendi evine taşınırsın. Ev sahibi Necdet Bey kirayı her yıl artırır.
• Aşık olursun, evlenirsin, çocukların olur. Annen arar. Kuzen Emre Amsterdam'dan kartpostal atar.
• Enflasyonla yarışırsın. Euro alırsın. Bir gün paradan üç sıfır atılır.

1 Gün, 1 Hafta, 1 Ay, 3 Ay, 1 Yıl, 5 Yıl, 10 Yıl, 100 Yıl ve en sonunda SONSUZ. Her onayla bir şehre gidersin: Selanik'ten Tokyo'ya, Reykjavik'ten Mars Kolonisi'ne. Pasaportun damgalarla dolar.

HAYAT DEVAM EDER
Bir gün hayatın biter. Dosya kapanmaz. Çocuğun ya da yeğenin mirasla birlikte aynı masaya oturur. Aile sicilin konsoloslukta hatırlanır. Yıllar 2026'dan 2100'lere akar; bürokrasi hiç ölmez.

• Piksel sanat: vesikalığın yaşla değişir, saçın ağarır, çocukların sana benzer.

• Günün Postası, rozetler, fotoğraf albümü, pasaport koleksiyonu, soy ağacı.
• İnternetsiz oynanır. Tek kişiliktir.
• Bir kez alırsın, hepsi senin. Reklam yok, uygulama içi satın alma yok.

Oyundaki kurumlar, memurlar, konsolosluklar ve kişiler hayal ürünüdür. Vize: Yaşam Simülasyonu hiçbir resmî kurumla bağlantılı değildir ve gerçek vize başvurusu yapmaz. Oyun dili Türkçedir.

tr.description:
般若心灯是一款佛教经典导读、念佛计数与佛乐聆听应用，帮助您随时随地诵读经文、聆听梵音、记录功课，在日常中安住身心、亲近佛法。

    【经书收录】
    收录心经、金刚经、普门品、药师经、普光明藏经、阿弥陀经、法华经、六祖坛经、楞严经、地藏经等经典，大悲咒、楞严咒、准提咒、百字明咒、往生咒、绿度母心咒等咒语真言，以及大忏悔文、回向文、课诵仪轨、药师经仪轨、地藏经
  前仪等课诵内容，共二十四部经典与仪轨，持续更新中。

    【课诵仪轨】
    香赞、净口业与净三业真言、安土地真言、普供养真言、开经偈为前行，补阙真言、普回向真言、三皈依为结行，诵持任一经典皆可依用；另立药师专篇，收药师赞、药师偈与药师灌顶真言。

    【逐字拼音】
    每一个汉字上方都标注了准确的拼音，方便初学者正确诵读经文，不再因生僻字而困扰。

    【白话文解释】
    关键经文配有通俗易懂的白话文解释，轻触即可查看，帮助您深入理解经文含义。

    【经文朗读】
    部分经典内置音频朗读，支持进度拖动、0.25x 至 2.0x 变速播放，以及后台与锁屏播放；未配音的经典仍可使用逐字拼音安心诵读。

    【歌词式阅读指示】
    阅读经文时，屏幕中央显示虚线定位指示器与当前行号，当前行高亮、远处渐淡，方便随时找回诵读位置。

    【佛乐聆听】
    精选 34 首佛教音乐，涵盖大悲咒、密咒真言、凡歌咏法、一心念佛等八大分类，支持播放列表、上下曲切换、进度拖动与变速播放，后台锁屏亦可聆听。可设 10 至 90 分钟定时关闭或「播完本曲」，到点前音量渐渐淡出，不会突然静下
  来。

    【佛珠念佛】
    轻触或沿珠串滑动即可拨珠计数，每颗都有木珠相碰的音效与触感反馈，108 颗圆满一圈。本次声数叠在佛珠环心，今日与本圈进度并列其下；长按佛珠可按本次、今日、累计分别归零。圣号可下拉切换或自行添加，拨珠音色可选佛珠或木
  鱼，振动强度分轻、中、强三档。自动记录今日声数与念佛时长，可一键生成水墨风格卡片分享今日修持。

    【自定义功课】
    可新建功课，设定名称、圣号、总目标与目标天数，每天该念多少自动算出。念佛页显示目标进度、剩余声数与今日完成情况，每份功课可单独设定回向文，发愿时自动填入；达成每日目标或圆满总目标时给出提示。

    【佛历】
    二十七个佛菩萨圣诞与初一、十五集中一页，按农历月分组，农历与公历对照，只列当年剩余的日子。可开启提醒，于前一日傍晚收到通知，斋日提醒可单独开关。

    【修行打卡】
    每日打卡记录修行，日历视图直观展示诵经轨迹，连续天数激励您坚持修行。偶尔忘记打卡也无妨，支持补打最近数日的功课，连续天数自动接上。

    【功德牌与足迹】
    诵读、打卡、念佛皆可累积功德牌，涵盖单经精进、广学多闻、持之以恒、念佛功课与佛菩萨圣诞时节。轻触日历上的打卡点，可回看那一天诵读过哪些经书，并为当日功课写下心愿。

    【发愿回向】
    念佛之后可写下愿文与回向，一日多愿亦可分别留档。所有发愿按时间成串收在「发愿记录」中，可随时修改或删除，日后回看重温初心。

tr.description:
AI 時代還要學程式設計嗎？事實是要，但已經不是過去的學習方式，怎麼說呢？以前的老前輩總是要學初學者先掌握一門程式語言，這裡所謂的掌握，拿 C 語言來舉例，就是要到能開發出 C 語言編譯器甚至到用 C 語言寫出作業系統，所以程式設計專科像是資訊工程系的課程就是這樣安排。

換句話說，過去的觀念強調用背誦培養，不管學生懂不懂，反正學生不懂也是可以先背起來，很多前輩的求學歷程不外都是先背了一堆知識，等到了未來某一天見到了某個知識點，才總算觸類旁通，以前不懂的，才在突然懂了，也就是到了特定知識點才對程式設計開竅。

先記住等到以後才弄懂的模式，坦白說是要在戰後快速培養人才，這樣記性好、學習效率高，也就是遴選出智商高的人才，問題是記性不等於悟性，所以記住是記住，卻不等於理解到懂的程度。

這就導致一種很詭異的現象，智商高的人記住了但是不懂，結果就是一直耍小聰明，賣弄他記住的知識，卻難以真正做創造或發明的工作，其實現在的 AI 幾乎可以說是就是智商極高的智能體， AI 可以依據提示詞做推論，但也僅只於推論而已，正確與否或是否符合需求則需要由另一套機制驗證。

所以 AI 強在可以跟你講知識，依據你輸入的文字推論你想要的結果，但目前的 AI 無法體察你言語間細微的變化，也無法分辨你言語的意思是否是 AI 能夠理解的意思，換句話說沒辦法察言觀色，也就是 AI 理解不了你懂或是不懂，或是你的理解與 AI 的理解是否相同，結果是你讓智商高的 AI 一直賣弄小聰明，向你堆知識，瞬間給你座圖書館，這就引出真正的難題，你不懂就不會用，你能做的頂多是跟 AI 一樣，依樣畫葫蘆，如果你不想畫一樣的葫蘆，你還是得懂。

正因為是弄懂了才會用，從另一種角度來講，懂了才知道要去記什麼，從而長出記性，多年的教學經驗給我的感受是讓多數學習程式設計的人，恍然大悟的知識點是弄懂產品的概念，換言之，從前是先學什麼是程式，從程式慢慢擴張到軟體，再從軟體的角度去學開發產品，這時候軟體規格到整個軟體的架構才出來，然後才懂得程式只是零件，所以說到頭，軟體開發是有了基本的邏輯概念後，去寫構成零件的程式，然後才能去組合零件到產品。

所以本 App 的設計理念反其道而行，從產品的角度出發，總共分成四個部份

基礎學習篇
軟體開發篇
GUI 篇
Brython 篇
「基礎學習篇」著重帶領學習者寫 Python 的小程式，藉此熟悉 Python 的語法，目的不是為了精通 Python 程式語言，而是為了「軟體開發篇」做準備。「軟體開發篇」從軟體規格出發，重點是繼續帶領學習者進一步開發能把英文句子編密碼的 Encrypt 類別。 Encrypt 類別作為「GUI 篇」的計算核心，繼續帶領學習者用 Tk 製作「編密碼小工具」的 GUI 視窗軟體。

-geany-
「Brython 篇」則是藉由第三方程式庫 Brython ，繼續把「邊密碼小工具」移植到網頁上。換言之，「編密碼小工具」就是本 App 依教學需求所開發的產品，這是一個宏觀的角度，先理解軟體的架構，再回推需要補強學習之處，畢竟現在電腦早已不再是先寫編譯器才能讓程式運作，也就是說，目的是讓學習者能先弄懂軟體開發是怎麼一回事，懂了軟體開發，往後再由其他管道，例如 AI 補強語法細節。

現階段 AI 還是一個提示詞給一組回應，當然也可以用如 agent 排程去做，講到提示詞就跟過去指令一樣，換句話說還沒走出自動化程式那一套， Python 就是適合在系統中寫自動化程式工作的程式語言。

有沒有發現一件事情，現在的 AI 是利用自然語言將工作自動化，但是維護能做自動化工作的 agent ，還是需要程式設計師，相對是要求經驗更豐富程式設計師，因此想要當程式設計師，就需要不斷的強化程式設計能力，如果能先弄懂軟體開發是什麼一回事，再來的程式語言的語法細節到電腦底層邏輯，本來很枯燥要死背的東西，一下子就變成有趣了起來。

有趣，學習才有意義，不是嗎？況且要自己手動寫出能跑得程式碼才有成就感，如果像前些日子從網路抄程式碼到現在跟 AI 要程式碼，那其實都不太會產生成就的快感，而且可能需要一直懊惱的除錯，說到這裡，無論網路或 AI 都是寶劍，你手持寶劍是要斬妖除魔，但如果你被寶劍反制控制住你的心靈，寶劍就無法成為你自身力量的延伸，那還不如棄之不用。

最後感謝購買本 App ，但由於每個人的基礎不同，希望本 App 設計的教學方式能對學習程式設計有所幫助。懂不是一件容易的事，但是總是要懂了才知道要怎麼做，做了才會有真正的幫助。

張凱慶 2026/05/13

tr.description:
RPGViewer is a player for your own RPG Maker and Flash projects, rebuilt from the ground up as a native iOS app.

You bring the game. RPGViewer runs it.

One app covers the engines you actually have projects in:

• RPG Maker XP, VX and VX Ace — run natively through a port of the original RGSS engine, not an imitation of it. Full speed, no browser in the middle.
• RPG Maker MV and MZ — full support, including OGG audio with no re-encoding.
• Flash (SWF) — played through Ruffle, including Flash games that were never converted to HTML5.
• HTML5 games — any self-contained page, opened from your library.

Saves work the way you expect
• Import existing save files. Drop in a .rpgsave or .rmmzsave from your desktop and it appears in the game's own browser save slots.
• Read the game's browser saves directly. Saves the browser version made on the same origin show up here, with title, playtime, location, party and level all decoded.
• Export back out. Take a save with you when you move to a new device.
• Separate storage per game. Each title keeps its own saves, its own port and its own settings — nothing bleeds across games.

Built for playing on a phone
• On-screen gamepad with remappable keys. Bind any physical or on-screen control to whatever the game reads.
• Real controller support. Connect a gamepad and it takes over, and the on-screen pad steps aside automatically.
• One consistent menu. The same control, in the same corner, on every engine — only the rows change, because only the rows that do something are shown.
• Fast-forward for native engine games.
• Works in landscape and portrait, iPhone and iPad.

RPG Maker MV and MZ only
• Cheat panel built into the menu — tweak values, items and party members without leaving the game.

Please note
• RPGViewer is a player only. It contains no games of its own, and it cannot download them. Please make sure the projects you run are obtained through legitimate channels.
• It is a generic runtime. It does not modify the source of RPG Maker or Flash projects, and it does not emulate them.
• Flash playback is provided by Ruffle. Games that depend on server-side components, or that require a network service, will not run.

Built for people making RPG Maker games: test your project on your phone before you ship it, and keep playing the games you already own.

pt.description:
Where you're born decides more about your life than almost anything you'll ever choose. 1in8b Life lets you feel that.

Press "Be born" and a point skips across the world map until it settles on one place: a city in Nigeria, a village in India, an apartment in Seoul, a farm in Bolivia. The odds are real. Countries with more babies come up more often, just as they do in life.

Then you live. Year by year, from your first word to your last breath.

A WHOLE LIFE, IN REAL NUMBERS
Your chances of surviving childhood, going to school, finding work, earning a living and growing old come from real data for 172 countries and territories. That data covers life expectancy, child mortality, income and inequality, schooling, fertility, health costs, conflict, natural hazards and more.

YOUR CHOICES STILL MATTER
Each year you decide where to spend your free time: study, career, family, health, faith, rest. You'll face hundreds of decisions: stay in school or help your family, move to the city, marry, have children, buy a home, invest, lend a friend money, flee a war, fight an illness. Every option shows its cost, its chances and its trade-offs. Effort counts, but circumstance pushes back.

THE PEOPLE AROUND YOU
Parents with names and jobs, brothers and sisters, a spouse, children and grandchildren, friends, pets. They grow up, grow old, move away and pass on. Your identity card, family panel and wealth breakdown show your whole life at a glance.

BORN IN THE SAME SECOND
Three other babies are born at the very moment you are, somewhere else in the world. Their lives unfold by the same rules. You'll hear how they go.

A LIFE RECORD TO KEEP
When your life ends, you get its full story: the turning points, the people, the numbers, how you compared with the rest of the world. Every life becomes a star in your sky of past lives. Share any of them as an image.

FEATURES
• 172 countries and territories, weighted by real birth rates
• Hundreds of events and decisions, with real odds shown
• Careers, school, marriage, children, migration, illness, war, recessions and inflation
• A pixel-art scene of your home and family that changes as you age
• Pauses at 5, 18, 30, 50 and 70 to reflect, and write down your thoughts
• Works offline. No account, no sign-up; your lives stay on your device

These lives are simulations, not predictions. They show the odds people face, not anyone's fate. Each one is a reminder of how much of a life is decided before it begins.


Where will you be born?

pt.releaseNotes: Cada vez mais conteúdo para o Digline! Diz-se que, para lá da casa do teu vizinho, à esquerda, chegou uma nova personagem misteriosa. E traz montes de experiências para testares na tua broca. Pelo menos algumas devem funcionar... talvez.
pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.

Uma versão 2D remodelada do quarto jogo da grandiosa série FINAL FANTASY! Aproveite a clássica história contada com um nostálgico visual retrô. Toda a magia do original, agora mais acessível.

O rei de Baron enviou sua força aérea de elite, os Asas Vermelhas, para atacar os reinos vizinhos. Cecil, um cavaleiro das trevas e capitão dos Asas Vermelhas, fica angustiado com a missão e decide enfrentar a tirania de Baron ao lado de seu leal amigo e de sua amada. Cecil viajará pela terra, pelo subterrâneo, à Terra dos Eidolons, e até mesmo à lua em busca dos cristais. Junte-se ao cavaleiro-dragão Kain, à maga branca Rosa, à invocadora Rydia e a vários outros aliados habilidosos.

FFIV é o primeiro da série a introduzir o dinâmico sistema de Batalha de Tempo Ativo, no qual o tempo não para mesmo durante o combate e dá aos jogadores a eletrizante sensação de urgência. Devido ao grande sucesso do jogo, este revolucionário sistema foi implementado em vários títulos subsequentes da série.

Não perca a dramática história e as batalhas dinâmicas do quarto jogo da série FINAL FANTASY!

---------------------------------------------

■ Lindamente reanimados com novos gráficos e sons!
・Gráficos pixelados 2D totalmente atualizados, incluindo os icônicos designs em pixel dos personagens de FINAL FANTASY criados por Kazuko Shibuya, o artista original e atual colaborador.
・Trilha sonora com novos arranjos belíssimos, fieis ao estilo de FINAL FANTASY, supervisionada pelo compositor original, Nobuo Uematsu.

Outline

The smash hit RPG: Final Fantasy VII, which has sold over 11,000,000 units* worldwide, finally arrives on iOS!
*Total includes both packaged sales and downloads.

The first Final Fantasy to feature 3D backgrounds and CG movie scenes, this dramatic tale continues to be loved by numerous fans around the world. Battle stages also appear in full 3D for the first time, bringing an even greater sense of awe and spectacle to combat!

Customize your characters in any way you like using the fantastic “material” system that allows endless combinations of spells and abilities.

This product is a port based on Final Fantasy VII for PC (No changes or additions have been made to the story). 


Story

With its unshakeable monopoly over Mako energy production, the evil Shinra Electric Power Company holds tight to the reigns of world power.
One day, a Mako reactor serving the sprawling metropolis of Midgar is attacked and destroyed in a bombing raid by a revolutionary group calling themselves Avalanche. 
Cloud Strife, a former member of Shinra’s elite “Soldier” unit takes part in the raid as a mercenary hired by Avalanche and sets events in motion that will draw him and his friends into an epic struggle for the fate of the planet itself…


Special features for the iOS edition 

- Play using a simple and comfortable virtual controller designed not to obscure the action, choosing between virtual analogue or fixed 4-way digital control pad options. The opacity of on-screen controls can also be adjusted from the Config Menu.

- Two new features to make play easier and more convenient!
The iOS edition also includes an option to turn enemy encounters off on the world and area maps (will not skip event battles) and a Max Stats command to become all-powerful in the blink of an eye.


Major game controls

Movement: Virtual joypad (Select between analogue and digital modes)
Menu navigation: Fixed digital buttons
Confirm: A button
Cancel: B button
Open menu: Y button

Final Fantasy III -- now on iPhone!

When darkness falls and the land is robbed of light, four youths are chosen by the crystals to embark upon a journey to save the world.

FINAL FANTASY III was the first title in the FINAL FANTASY series to become a million-seller, establishing once and for all that Square Enix's classic RPG saga was here to stay.

A hallmark of innovation for the entire series, FINAL FANTASY III incorporates not only a job system that lets characters change classes at any time to the ability to summon powerful creatures such as Shiva and Bahamut.

The 3D remake of FINAL FANTASY III, with fully-rendered 3D graphics, duplicated the original's success.

- The four protagonists have been completely redesigned and new scenarios have been added.

- The 3D remake has really brought the cutscenes and battles to life.

- The Job system has been improved to bring out its best and most unique aspects, resulting in a more balanced game that is easy to enjoy.

- New save functions, including autosave, allow for players to quit the game at any time without fear of losing their progress.

--------------------------------------------

Aditionally, the smartphone version has been improved to include the following:

- High resolution graphics and retouched cutscenes.

- Smooth, intuitive touch-panel controls specifically tailored to improve the gaming experience.

- Gallery Mode, where players can view  illustrations from the game  or listen to the soundtrack, has been added.

- New visual designs for the Job Mastery Cards and the Mognet .

[Please read before playing]

* Entering or leaving vehicles such as cars and the Garden may occasionally get your character stuck between the vehicle and terrain features, or freeze the vehicle in place. This seems to happen more often when you leave your vehicle in close proximity to impassable terrain, or when you try to enter or leave your vehicle during certain scripted events. Currently, the only fix for this is to reload a previously saved game, so please make sure to save your progress often.

* Some locations may be difficult to navigate using the Speed Boost (x3). We advise you to turn off this feature in such cases.

* Make sure to check the FAQ section of our support page for solutions to common issues:
https://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?la=1&id=442

We apologize for any inconvenience these issues may cause, and thank you again for your interest in our product.

■Summary
FINAL FANTASY VIII was first released on February 11, 1999. Beloved by fans, this title has garnered a great deal of popularity even compared to other installments in the FINAL FANTASY franchise, selling more than 9.6 million units worldwide. And now players can enjoy FINAL FANTASY VIII on their smartphone! With renewed character CG, the world of FINAL FANTASY VIII is now more beautiful than ever before.

This installment is a remaster of FINAL FANTASY VIII for PC. This application is a one-time purchase. There will be no additional charge incurred after downloading.

■Story
It is a time of war.
The Republic of Galbadia, under the influence of the sorceress Edea, mobilizes its great armies against the other nations of the world.
Squall and other members of SeeD, an elite mercenary force, join hands with Rinoa, a resistance fighter, to fight against Galbadia's tyrannical rule and to prevent Edea from fulfilling her ultimate goal.

■FINAL FANTASY VIII: Release Features
・Guardian Force（G.F.）
G.F. are summoned creatures in FFVIII used to protect the protagonists. Call upon them in battle to unleash their might and to increase their power alongside player characters. By junctioning G.F., players will be able to enjoy greater freedom in how they approach battles.

・Drawing
Obtain magic in FFVIII by drawing (extracting) it in battle. MP does not exist and players are limited to the number they have in their possession. Magic that has been extracted can be released on the spot or stocked for later use.

・ Junctioning
This system allows players to equip G.F. and stocked magic to characters in order to increase their power.

■ Additional Features
・ Battle Assist
Max out HP and ATB gauge during battle and activate Limit Breaks at any time.
・ No Encounters
Players can choose to turn Battle Encounters on or off.
・ 3x Speed
With the exception of certain cutscenes, players can choose to proceed through the game at 3x speed.

iOS 15.0 or higher

pt.description:
般若心灯是一款佛教经典导读、念佛计数与佛乐聆听应用，帮助您随时随地诵读经文、聆听梵音、记录功课，在日常中安住身心、亲近佛法。

    【经书收录】
    收录心经、金刚经、普门品、药师经、普光明藏经、阿弥陀经、法华经、六祖坛经、楞严经、地藏经等经典，大悲咒、楞严咒、准提咒、百字明咒、往生咒、绿度母心咒等咒语真言，以及大忏悔文、回向文、课诵仪轨、药师经仪轨、地藏经
  前仪等课诵内容，共二十四部经典与仪轨，持续更新中。

    【课诵仪轨】
    香赞、净口业与净三业真言、安土地真言、普供养真言、开经偈为前行，补阙真言、普回向真言、三皈依为结行，诵持任一经典皆可依用；另立药师专篇，收药师赞、药师偈与药师灌顶真言。

    【逐字拼音】
    每一个汉字上方都标注了准确的拼音，方便初学者正确诵读经文，不再因生僻字而困扰。

    【白话文解释】
    关键经文配有通俗易懂的白话文解释，轻触即可查看，帮助您深入理解经文含义。

    【经文朗读】
    部分经典内置音频朗读，支持进度拖动、0.25x 至 2.0x 变速播放，以及后台与锁屏播放；未配音的经典仍可使用逐字拼音安心诵读。

    【歌词式阅读指示】
    阅读经文时，屏幕中央显示虚线定位指示器与当前行号，当前行高亮、远处渐淡，方便随时找回诵读位置。

    【佛乐聆听】
    精选 34 首佛教音乐，涵盖大悲咒、密咒真言、凡歌咏法、一心念佛等八大分类，支持播放列表、上下曲切换、进度拖动与变速播放，后台锁屏亦可聆听。可设 10 至 90 分钟定时关闭或「播完本曲」，到点前音量渐渐淡出，不会突然静下
  来。

    【佛珠念佛】
    轻触或沿珠串滑动即可拨珠计数，每颗都有木珠相碰的音效与触感反馈，108 颗圆满一圈。本次声数叠在佛珠环心，今日与本圈进度并列其下；长按佛珠可按本次、今日、累计分别归零。圣号可下拉切换或自行添加，拨珠音色可选佛珠或木
  鱼，振动强度分轻、中、强三档。自动记录今日声数与念佛时长，可一键生成水墨风格卡片分享今日修持。

    【自定义功课】
    可新建功课，设定名称、圣号、总目标与目标天数，每天该念多少自动算出。念佛页显示目标进度、剩余声数与今日完成情况，每份功课可单独设定回向文，发愿时自动填入；达成每日目标或圆满总目标时给出提示。

    【佛历】
    二十七个佛菩萨圣诞与初一、十五集中一页，按农历月分组，农历与公历对照，只列当年剩余的日子。可开启提醒，于前一日傍晚收到通知，斋日提醒可单独开关。

    【修行打卡】
    每日打卡记录修行，日历视图直观展示诵经轨迹，连续天数激励您坚持修行。偶尔忘记打卡也无妨，支持补打最近数日的功课，连续天数自动接上。

    【功德牌与足迹】
    诵读、打卡、念佛皆可累积功德牌，涵盖单经精进、广学多闻、持之以恒、念佛功课与佛菩萨圣诞时节。轻触日历上的打卡点，可回看那一天诵读过哪些经书，并为当日功课写下心愿。

    【发愿回向】
    念佛之后可写下愿文与回向，一日多愿亦可分别留档。所有发愿按时间成串收在「发愿记录」中，可随时修改或删除，日后回看重温初心。

    【修行回顾】
    按年汇总修行天数、最长连续与常诵经典，生成水墨风格回顾卡片，可保存分享。

    【iCloud 同步】
    开启后，打卡记录、功德牌、诵经进度、自定义功课与圣号在您的各台设备间保持一致，无需额外费用。

    【个性设置】
    支持夜间模式，经文字号自由调节，打造舒适的阅读体验。

    【收藏与进度】
    收藏常读经书，自动记录阅读进度，每次打开都能继续上次的修行。

    般若心灯，愿以智慧之光，照亮您的修行之路。

pt.description:
AI 時代還要學程式設計嗎？事實是要，但已經不是過去的學習方式，怎麼說呢？以前的老前輩總是要學初學者先掌握一門程式語言，這裡所謂的掌握，拿 C 語言來舉例，就是要到能開發出 C 語言編譯器甚至到用 C 語言寫出作業系統，所以程式設計專科像是資訊工程系的課程就是這樣安排。

換句話說，過去的觀念強調用背誦培養，不管學生懂不懂，反正學生不懂也是可以先背起來，很多前輩的求學歷程不外都是先背了一堆知識，等到了未來某一天見到了某個知識點，才總算觸類旁通，以前不懂的，才在突然懂了，也就是到了特定知識點才對程式設計開竅。

先記住等到以後才弄懂的模式，坦白說是要在戰後快速培養人才，這樣記性好、學習效率高，也就是遴選出智商高的人才，問題是記性不等於悟性，所以記住是記住，卻不等於理解到懂的程度。

這就導致一種很詭異的現象，智商高的人記住了但是不懂，結果就是一直耍小聰明，賣弄他記住的知識，卻難以真正做創造或發明的工作，其實現在的 AI 幾乎可以說是就是智商極高的智能體， AI 可以依據提示詞做推論，但也僅只於推論而已，正確與否或是否符合需求則需要由另一套機制驗證。

所以 AI 強在可以跟你講知識，依據你輸入的文字推論你想要的結果，但目前的 AI 無法體察你言語間細微的變化，也無法分辨你言語的意思是否是 AI 能夠理解的意思，換句話說沒辦法察言觀色，也就是 AI 理解不了你懂或是不懂，或是你的理解與 AI 的理解是否相同，結果是你讓智商高的 AI 一直賣弄小聰明，向你堆知識，瞬間給你座圖書館，這就引出真正的難題，你不懂就不會用，你能做的頂多是跟 AI 一樣，依樣畫葫蘆，如果你不想畫一樣的葫蘆，你還是得懂。

正因為是弄懂了才會用，從另一種角度來講，懂了才知道要去記什麼，從而長出記性，多年的教學經驗給我的感受是讓多數學習程式設計的人，恍然大悟的知識點是弄懂產品的概念，換言之，從前是先學什麼是程式，從程式慢慢擴張到軟體，再從軟體的角度去學開發產品，這時候軟體規格到整個軟體的架構才出來，然後才懂得程式只是零件，所以說到頭，軟體開發是有了基本的邏輯概念後，去寫構成零件的程式，然後才能去組合零件到產品。

所以本 App 的設計理念反其道而行，從產品的角度出發，總共分成四個部份

基礎學習篇
軟體開發篇
GUI 篇
Brython 篇
「基礎學習篇」著重帶領學習者寫 Python 的小程式，藉此熟悉 Python 的語法，目的不是為了精通 Python 程式語言，而是為了「軟體開發篇」做準備。「軟體開發篇」從軟體規格出發，重點是繼續帶領學習者進一步開發能把英文句子編密碼的 Encrypt 類別。 Encrypt 類別作為「GUI 篇」的計算核心，繼續帶領學習者用 Tk 製作「編密碼小工具」的 GUI 視窗軟體。

-geany-
「Brython 篇」則是藉由第三方程式庫 Brython ，繼續把「邊密碼小工具」移植到網頁上。換言之，「編密碼小工具」就是本 App 依教學需求所開發的產品，這是一個宏觀的角度，先理解軟體的架構，再回推需要補強學習之處，畢竟現在電腦早已不再是先寫編譯器才能讓程式運作，也就是說，目的是讓學習者能先弄懂軟體開發是怎麼一回事，懂了軟體開發，往後再由其他管道，例如 AI 補強語法細節。

現階段 AI 還是一個提示詞給一組回應，當然也可以用如 agent 排程去做，講到提示詞就跟過去指令一樣，換句話說還沒走出自動化程式那一套， Python 就是適合在系統中寫自動化程式工作的程式語言。

有沒有發現一件事情，現在的 AI 是利用自然語言將工作自動化，但是維護能做自動化工作的 agent ，還是需要程式設計師，相對是要求經驗更豐富程式設計師，因此想要當程式設計師，就需要不斷的強化程式設計能力，如果能先弄懂軟體開發是什麼一回事，再來的程式語言的語法細節到電腦底層邏輯，本來很枯燥要死背的東西，一下子就變成有趣了起來。

有趣，學習才有意義，不是嗎？況且要自己手動寫出能跑得程式碼才有成就感，如果像前些日子從網路抄程式碼到現在跟 AI 要程式碼，那其實都不太會產生成就的快感，而且可能需要一直懊惱的除錯，說到這裡，無論網路或 AI 都是寶劍，你手持寶劍是要斬妖除魔，但如果你被寶劍反制控制住你的心靈，寶劍就無法成為你自身力量的延伸，那還不如棄之不用。

最後感謝購買本 App ，但由於每個人的基礎不同，希望本 App 設計的教學方式能對學習程式設計有所幫助。懂不是一件容易的事，但是總是要懂了才知道要怎麼做，做了才會有真正的幫助。

張凱慶 2026/05/13

pt.description:
O RPGViewer é um reprodutor para os teus próprios projetos de RPG Maker e Flash, reescrito de raiz como aplicação nativa para iOS.

O jogo é teu. O RPGViewer executa-o.

Uma só aplicação para os motores em que realmente tens projetos:

* RPG Maker XP, VX e VX Ace: correm nativamente através de um port do motor RGSS original, e não de uma imitação. Velocidade total, sem navegador pelo meio.
* RPG Maker MV e MZ: suporte completo, incluindo áudio OGG sem necessidade de recodificar.
* Flash (SWF): corre com o Ruffle, incluindo jogos Flash que nunca foram convertidos para HTML5.
* Jogos HTML5: qualquer página autónoma, aberta a partir da tua biblioteca.

As gravações funcionam como esperas
* Importa gravações existentes. Coloca um ficheiro .rpgsave ou .rmmzsave do teu computador e ele aparece nos espaços de gravação do navegador do próprio jogo.
* Lê diretamente as gravações do navegador do jogo. As gravações criadas pela versão de navegador na mesma origem aparecem aqui, com título, tempo de jogo, localização, grupo e nível descodificados.
* Exporta de novo. Leva uma gravação contigo quando mudares de dispositivo.
* Armazenamento separado por jogo. Cada título tem as suas próprias gravações, a sua própria porta e as suas próprias definições: nada se mistura entre jogos.

Feito para jogar no telemóvel
* Comando no ecrã com teclas reatribuíveis. Atribui qualquer botão físico ou no ecrã à tecla que o jogo lê.
* Suporte para comandos reais. Ao ligar um, ele assume o controlo e o comando no ecrã retira-se sozinho.
* Um menu consistente. O mesmo controlo, no mesmo canto, em qualquer motor: só as linhas mudam, porque só aparecem as que fazem alguma coisa.
* Avanço rápido nos jogos do motor nativo.
* Retrato e paisagem, em iPhone e iPad.

Apenas para RPG Maker MV e MZ
* Painel de truques no menu: ajusta valores, objetos e membros do grupo sem sair do jogo.

Atenção
* O RPGViewer é apenas um reprodutor. Não contém jogos próprios nem os pode descarregar. Verifica se os projetos que executas foram obtidos por meios legais.
* É um ambiente de execução genérico: não modifica o código-fonte dos projetos de RPG Maker ou Flash, nem os emula.
* A reprodução de Flash é fornecida pelo Ruffle. Os jogos que dependem de componentes do servidor, ou que exigem um serviço de rede, não funcionarão.

Para quem cria jogos em RPG Maker: testa o teu projeto no telemóvel antes de o publicar e continua a jogar os jogos que já tens.

pt.description:
RadarScope is an AMS-award-winning weather visualization tool that empowers meteorologists, public safety officials, storm spotters, and weather enthusiasts to view a full suite of single-site radar data and related severe weather products. Your initial purchase provides professional radar visualization in a fully native app, free from distracting and invasive practices, with optional subscription packages to add even more capabilities.

Whether you’re scanning for a mesocyclone’s tell-tale hook echo, pinpointing the landfall of a hurricane’s eye wall, or identifying velocity couplet, hail spike, or debris ball signatures, RadarScope displays native radar data in its original radial format. You see what the radar sees almost as soon as the radar sees it, with automatic updates every two to ten minutes depending on the radar’s scanning strategy.

Your initial app purchase includes the following:

• Full suite of single-site radar products for the US, Canada, Guam, Denmark, Finland, and Germany
• 10-frame radar loops
• Two built-in providers for radar data
• Tornado, thunderstorm, flash flood, marine, snow squall, extreme wind, tropical, and other warnings in the US
• Selected severe weather warnings in Canada and Australia
• Severe weather watches in the US and Canada
• NWS-generated storm tracks with hail, TVS, and mesocyclone attributes
• Inspector and distance tools
• Color palette options for radar data
• Weather Pulse data plan integration
• Spotter Network integration for storm and location reporting
• mPING integration for submitting weather reports to NSSL
• Bundled maps with political borders, water bodies, and highways, optimized for low-bandwidth use
• Support for widgets and complications
• Universal app for Apple platforms, including Apple Watch, and Apple TV
• CarPlay support
• Family Sharing support

RadarScope Pro Tier One is an optional annual subscription that adds more features for tracking severe weather:

• 30-frame radar loops
• Cloud-to-ground lightning strikes
• Special weather statements in the US and Canada
• Mesoscale convective and precipitation discussions
• SPC convective, tornado, hail, wind, and fire outlooks
• WPC excessive rainfall outlooks in the US
• Local storm reports in the US
• Custom color palette support
• Multi-pane display (2 on phones; 4 on larger devices)
• Family Sharing support

RadarScope Pro Tier Two is an optional annual or monthly subscription that transforms RadarScope into a more complete visualization tool for a larger suite of weather products, including:

• Everything in Pro Tier One
• 50-frame radar loops
• A third provider for US radar data
• 30-year archive of NEXRAD Level II radar data
• 6-year archive of NEXRAD Level III data
• 30-day archive of super-res and non-US radar data
• 20-year archive of NWS bulletins
• GOES satellite data
• Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) data
• Real-Time Mesoscale Assimilation (RTMA) data
• GFS, ECMWF, HRRR, HRW, NAM, and RRFS model data
• Surface observations
• ProbSevere layer
• Atmospheric soundings in the US
• Hail size, hail probability, and azimuthal shear contours with a 30-day archive
• More detailed transportation and satellite imagery maps
• Custom color palette support for GOES, MRMS, RTMA, and forecast products
• Server-sent events for radar and warning updates
• Cross-platform subscription sharing on up to 5 devices

If you choose to buy a RadarScope Pro subscription, it will be charged to your App Store account. The subscription will be auto-renewed within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price you originally paid. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal disabled via your App Store account settings after the purchase. Once purchased, the subscription cannot be canceled during the active subscription period.

DTN is committed to safeguarding your privacy online. Our privacy policy is available for review at https://www.dtn.com/privacy-policy/

Please visit our web site for more information.
